title: Project configuration
description: Per-project configuration file (galivelop-images.json) read by the image generator.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

minVersion.description: Minimum generator version (semver) this project requires.

name.description: Project name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

delivery.description: Where finished images are delivered inside the project repository.

dir.description: Delivery directory, relative to the project root.

template.description: File name template for delivered images; must contain {key} and {profile}, use only letters, digits, . _ - and /, stay relative without .. segments, and end in .png.

manifest.description: Manifest file path, relative to the project root.

profiles.description: Image profiles by name (size, sampling settings, model, style).

profileName.description: Profile name: lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, no hyphens (the profile is what follows the last hyphen in delivered file names).

relativePath.description: Relative path that cannot be absolute, start with ~, contain .. segments, backslashes or control characters.

style.description: Fixed text appended to every prompt of this profile.

draft.description: How a draft of this profile differs (D32). Without it a draft is half the sides, 8 steps, same model.

scale.description: Factor on width and height; each side is rounded to a multiple of 64 (minimum 64).

targetWidth.description: Delivered width in pixels (needs targetHeight); without it the delivered size is the generation size.

compose.description: Composition (D28): an SVG template with {{field}} holes and an optional logo is laid over the raw image, scaled to the target size.

template.description: SVG template, relative to the project root.

logo.description: Logo SVG, relative to the project root; the template uses it as {{logo}}.

fields.description: Text fields the template takes; an order gives them in `text`.

fonts.description: Font families the template uses; `gimg doctor` checks they are installed.

fit.description: cover crops the raw image to the target; contain scales it down and the template paints the bands.

svgPath.description: Relative path to an .svg file, with the same limits as any relative path.

fieldName.description: Name of a text field of the composition template ({{name}}): starts with a lowercase letter, letters and digits only; "logo" is reserved.
